data.name: Metal: Hellsinger VR
data.detailed_description:
Step into the half-demon body of The Unknown and feel the pulse of metal rage through you.
Metal: Hellsinger VR redesigns the acclaimed rhythm shooter from the ground up, placing its infernal arsenal straight into your hands and the fires of Hell at your feet. Experience an unparallelled state of flow as you move, dash, and aim in full VR.

Enjoy a range of features from the original game, including the full epic campaign, Archdevil difficulty, Torment Challenges, and Beat Assist Mode, reimagined for VR.



Shoot to the beat to make the music unfold and your power grow. See the world around you pulsate to the rhythm and be unburdened by a traditional interface.



Composer duo Two Feathers have created a thunderous original score, with vocals by metal icons such as Serj Tankian (System of a Down), Randy Blythe (Lamb of God), Alissa White-Gluz (Arch Enemy), and more!

🏆 Winner, MCV/Develop Award for Audio Innovation of the Year, 2023
🏆 Winner, Golden Joystick Award for Best Audio, 2022
🏆 Winner, Tin Pan Alley Game Music Award, 2022
🏆 Winner, Spawnies Award for Best Music, 2022
🏆🏆🏆 Winner, NAVGTR Awards for Outstanding Song Collection, Outstanding Original Light Mix Score (New IP), and Outstanding Game, Music, or Performance-Based, 2022
🏆 Nominee, DICE Awards Outstanding Achievement in Original Music Composition, 2023
🏆 Nominee, BAFTA Awards Audio Achievement, 2023
🏆 Nominee, The Game Awards Best Score and Music, 2022
🏆 Nominee, The Steam Awards Best Soundtrack, 2022



The Red Judge stole your voice. For that, there must be a reckoning. Experience the epic story of revenge from a closer perspective. Embark on an infernal ride through the Eight Hells accompanied by award-winning actors Troy Baker and Jennifer Hale.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Index Controllers, Meta Quest Touch Controllers and HTC VIVE Wands. Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, HTC VIVE, and Steam Index.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX™ 2080 / AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR on SteamVR with Index Controllers, Meta Quest Touch Controllers and HTC VIVE Wands. Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, HTC VIVE, and Steam Index.
